mainEntity.name: When is the punch list usually created during a construction project?

acceptedAnswer.text: The punch list is typically created during the final stages of a construction project, often just before substantial completion. This is when the majority of the work is done, and the property is nearly ready for occupancy or use. For Frasheski Construction, we conduct a joint walk-through with the client at this point to meticulously identify and document any last details needing attention, ensuring that minor defects or incomplete tasks are addressed promptly before final handover.
acceptedAnswer.description: The punch list is usually created in the final stages of a construction project, just before substantial completion, during a joint walk-through with the client.
